decks.notes: The deck focuses on assembling a toolbox of creatures with various abilities to support its combo strategy. The deck utilizes cards like Chord of Calling and Eldritch Evolution to tutor for key creatures, such as Yawgmoth, Thran Physician and Grist, the Hunger Tide. By sacrificing creatures and utilizing abilities like persist and undying, the deck aims to generate value and disrupt the opponent's strategy. The creatures in the deck are versatile and can provide both aggression and disruption, allowing for a flexible and adaptive gameplay.

This deck revolves around quickly assembling the combo of Puresteel Paladin, Colossus Hammer, and Sigarda's Aid to equip the Hammer to the Paladin and swing for lethal infect damage with Inkmoth Nexus. The deck also includes various protection spells and equipment to ensure the combo can be safely executed. Urza's Saga is used to tutor for key pieces of the combo, while also providing additional utility in finding additional threats or disruption. The goal is to quickly put together the combo and overwhelm the opponent before they can establish their own game plan.

This deck focuses on using aggressive creatures like Tarmogoyf and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer to quickly overwhelm opponents. With efficient removal spells like Lightning Bolt and Fatal Push, as well as disruption like Thoughtseize, the deck aims to control the board while applying pressure. The inclusion of cards like Wrenn and Six and Urza's Saga provide additional value and flexibility. Additionally, the deck benefits from its companion, Jegantha, the Wellspring, allowing for an extra mana source. Overall, the deck aims to be aggressive, disruptive, and versatile in order to outpace and outsmart opponents.

This deck focuses on utilizing cards like Indomitable Creativity and Transmogrify to cheat out powerful creatures like Archon of Cruelty onto the battlefield quickly. It also includes control elements like Teferi, Time Raveler and Spell Pierce to protect the combo pieces and disrupt opponents. The combination of efficient removal spells like Lightning Bolt and Prismari Command with powerful threats allows the deck to quickly close out games and outmaneuver opponents. The inclusion of Leyline Binding helps to further control the opponent's board and seal the victory.

Utilizing a combination of recursion, tutoring, and sacrifice mechanics, this deck aims to swarm the board with a variety of creatures and artifacts, leveraging the synergies between them to overwhelm the opponent quickly. The Underworld Cookbook serves as a key piece in both enabling the deck's strategy and providing card advantage, while cards like Fatestitcher and Ovalchase Daredevil ensure efficient plays and resource management. By consistently applying pressure and maintaining momentum, this aggressive archetype seeks to outpace and outmaneuver opponents in fast-paced Modern matchups.

This deck focuses on quickly deploying a swarm of small, efficient creatures to overwhelm your opponent before they can stabilize. By combining powerful white weenies with disruptive creatures like Thalia, Guardian of Thraben and Esper Sentinel, you can disrupt your opponent's game plan while building up a threatening board presence. Emeria's Call provides a late-game finisher in case the game goes long, ensuring you have multiple angles of attack to secure victory. The deck aims to be aggressive, disruptive, and resilient, giving you a versatile toolkit to take on a variety of matchups in the Modern format.

This deck focuses on quickly building a board presence with strong Merfolk creatures and utilizing disruptive spells and abilities to control the opponent's resources. By using lord effects to pump up your creatures and disruption like Merfolk Trickster and Subtlety to deal with threats, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a fast and aggressive strategy. The inclusion of Aether Vial allows for efficient creature deployment and Cavern of Souls ensures that your Merfolk spells can't be countered. Overall, this deck seeks to outpace and outmaneuver the opponent to achieve victory.

The deck focuses on quickly assembling the combo of Puresteel Paladin, Colossus Hammer, and Sigarda's Aid to equip the hammer for free and deal massive damage with creature tokens. The deck also includes support cards like Stoneforge Mystic, Inkmoth Nexus, and Urza's Saga to search for key pieces and protect the combo from disruption. With the ability to quickly assemble and execute its combo, the deck aims to overwhelm opponents before they can react effectively.

The main concept of this deck is to use Cascade cards like Violent Outburst to cheat out powerful spells like Crashing Footfalls and Fury. By combining aggressive creatures like Brazen Borrower with Cascade spells, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent quickly while controlling the board with cards like Force of Negation and Dead / Gone. The deck also utilizes mana-fixing lands like Gemstone Caverns and fetchlands to ensure consistency in its mana base, allowing it to consistently cast its powerful spells and maintain pressure on the opponent.

The main concept of this deck is to apply aggressive pressure on the opponent using a combination of efficient spells and creatures, with a focus on leveraging the graveyard for value. By utilizing cards like Murktide Regent and Dragon's Rage Channeler alongside powerful spells like Lightning Bolt and Counterspell, the deck aims to quickly chip away at the opponent's life total while disrupting their game plan. Additionally, the inclusion of cards like Mishra's Bauble and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer helps generate card advantage and provide additional threats to overwhelm the opponent.

This UR Aggro deck focuses on quickly building a board presence through efficient creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Murktide Regent, while disrupting opponents with Counterspell and Spell Pierce. Lightning Bolt and Unholy Heat provide removal options, while Expressive Iteration and Consider offer card advantage. The deck aims to apply pressure early and maintain tempo throughout the game, using a mix of creatures, spells, and disruption to control the board and overwhelm the opponent. It prioritizes fast, aggressive plays to close out games swiftly.

The deck is focused on exploiting the synergy between Underworld Breach and various cards that allow for repeatable card advantage and cheap spells, such as Mishra's Bauble and Expressive Iteration. The goal is to quickly assemble the combo pieces needed to cast spells from the graveyard using Underworld Breach, while utilizing disruptive elements like Teferi, Time Raveler and Spell Pierce to protect the combo. Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer provides additional value and pressure on the opponent, allowing for a versatile and fast-paced gameplay style.

This deck aims to aggressively deal damage to the opponent as quickly as possible using efficient burn spells and fast creatures. It focuses on playing low-cost spells and creatures to maintain pressure and prevent the opponent from stabilizing. The mana base is built to support the deck's aggressive strategy, with a mix of fetch lands, shock lands, and utility lands. The deck is designed to close out games quickly before the opponent can establish a board presence or gain control.

The deck revolves around utilizing Underworld Breach to continuously cast spells from the graveyard, fueling powerful combo plays with cards like Dragon's Rage Channeler and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer. It includes a mix of card draw, removal, and disruption to ensure consistency and protection for the combo. The deck aims to quickly assemble the necessary pieces to overwhelm the opponent with high-powered plays while efficiently cycling through the deck with cards like Expressive Iteration and Mishra's Bauble. Jegantha, the Wellspring provides additional value and flexibility as a companion option.

The main concept of this deck is to use the Cascade mechanic to cast powerful spells for free, overwhelming the opponent with a fast and aggressive strategy. By utilizing cards like Shardless Agent and Violent Outburst, the deck aims to quickly put pressure on the opponent and close out the game before they have a chance to stabilize. With a mix of disruptive spells and efficient threats, the deck seeks to maintain tempo and control of the game while constantly applying pressure to the opponent.

The primary focus of this deck is to win quickly through aggressive creatures and efficient countermagic. By utilizing cards like Lightning Bolt and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer, the deck aims to deal damage quickly to the opponent while also disrupting their game plan with counterspells like Counterspell and Spell Pierce. The inclusion of Murktide Regent provides a powerful threat that can dominate the board. Mishra's Bauble and Expressive Iteration help to dig for key cards, while Unholy Heat provides removal options. Overall, this deck is designed to apply pressure early and capitalize on tempo advantages.
